label: Formulated and introduced Deconstruction & Différance
description: Jacques Derrida formulated and introduced the concept of "Deconstruction & Différance", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Jacques Derrida's canonical writings.

label: Zupančič distinguishes the Lacanian Real from deconstructive undecidability, defending the indestructible traumatic kernel of the subject
description: Alenka Zupančič engaged in a direct critique of Jacques Derrida's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Jacques Derrida's perspective to Alenka Zupančič's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
